24struct SensorOutlierInjectionParams {
25 /* Probability that an input sample is replaced by an outlier. */
26 double probability = 0.0;
27 /* An outlier's values are uniform in [-range, range). */
28 double range = 0.0;
29 /* With rotation, the input is two rows of a rotation matrix (6 values) and an outlier is two rows
30 * of a uniformly random rotation instead. */
31 bool rotation = false;
32 SensorRandomParams random;

39 MOCHI_STRUCT_END()
40};

42/* @brief Replaces whole input samples by outliers with a fixed probability, drawn once per input
43 * publication from the episode seed, the stream key and the input's published step. Other samples
44 * pass unchanged. */
45class MOCHI_API SensorOutlierInjection final : public SensorBase {
46 public:
47 using Params = SensorOutlierInjectionParams;
48 static constexpr std::string_view TypeName() {
49 return "SENSOR_OUTLIER_INJECTION";
50 }
51 SensorOutlierInjection(Actor* actor, std::string_view paramArgs, Error& error);
52 explicit SensorOutlierInjection(Params const& params, Error& error);
53 [[nodiscard]] std::string_view GetTypeName() const override {
54 return TypeName();
55 }
56 [[nodiscard]] Params GetParams() const {
57 return _params;
58 }
59 /* Install episode parameters before the caller resets the graph. */
60 void SetParams(Params const& params, Error& error);
61 [[nodiscard]] SensorStepResult Step(StepTime const& now, Error& error) override;
62 [[nodiscard]] Span<std::byte const> TryGetMetadata(std::string_view key) const override;
63
64 private:
65 [[nodiscard]] SensorFormat InitSensor(SensorScope const& scope, Error& error) override;
66 void ResetSensor() override;
67
68 Params _params;
69 DynamicArray<float> _outlier;
70 int64_t _lastInputPublishedStep = -1;
71};
